business.description: The Company, along with the Erstwhile Proprietary Firm M/s Vijay & Co., has been engaged in the business of construction and real estate development since 2015 and 2014, respectively, with a primary focus on residential and commercial projects in and around Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The Company focuses on developing residential villas and apartments with emphasis on innovative architecture, quality construction and effective project execution, catering primarily to middle-income and high-income customer segments.

products.name: Residential villas and apartments
